mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointments (department_id, doctor_id, patient_id, date_time, purpose, status, bill_amount) VALUES (#{departmentId}, #{doctorId}, #{patientId}, #{dateTime}, #{purpose}, #{status}, #{billAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, department_id, doctor_id, patient_id, date_time, purpose, status, bill_amount FROM appointments

SELECT appt.id AS appointment_id, appt.status AS appointment_status, appt.bill_amount, h.name AS hospital_name, h.address AS hospital_address, d.name AS department_name, r.number AS room_number, doc.full_name AS doctor_name, doc.specialty AS doctor_specialty, doc.email AS doctor_email, p.full_name AS patient_name, p.phone AS patient_phone, appt.date_time, tr.diagnosis, pr.medication, ins.policy_number, it.name AS insurance_type, adm.admitted_date, adm.discharge_date, adm.status FROM appointments appt JOIN departments d ON appt.department_id = d.id JOIN hospitals h ON d.hospital_id = h.id JOIN doctors doc ON appt.doctor_id = doc.id LEFT JOIN patients p ON appt.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN rooms r ON r.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN insurances ins ON p.insurance_id = ins.id LEFT JOIN insurance_types it ON ins.insurance_type_id = it.id LEFT JOIN treatments tr ON tr.patient_id = p.id AND tr.doctor_id = doc.id LEFT JOIN prescriptions pr ON pr.treatment_id = tr.id LEFT JOIN admissions adm ON adm.patient_id = p.id WHERE appt.date_time >= #{fromDateTime} ORDER BY appt.date_time
mapper.update: UPDATE appointments SET department_id = #{departmentId}, doctor_id = #{doctorId}, patient_id = #{patientId}, date_time = #{dateTime}, purpose = #{purpose}, status = #{status}, bill_amount = #{billAmount} WHERE id = #{id}
